Lessons.Title: Interpret Remainders in Division Situations
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will represent and solve contextual problems that involve dividing a whole number of up to four-digits by a single-digit divisor, resulting in a number with or without a remainder.
By now you have developed various strategies to divide multi-digit numbers by single-digit divisors and have used different representations along the way.
Source activity sequence: Warm-up: Choral Count: 2, 3, and 5 (10 minutes); Activity 1: Muffins and Seats (15 minutes); Activity 2: Save for a Garden (20 minutes); Cool-down: Miscounting? (5 minutes)
Exact mathematical focus: Interpret the remainder according to what the quantities mean rather than mechanically rounding.

Edulytics authored model: 378 muffins into boxes of 4 gives 94 complete boxes and 2 muffins remaining. One more box is needed, so the number of boxes is 95. For monthly savings: (1270 − 6) ÷ 8 = 158 saved per month.
First-party Cool-down: How many 8-seat buses are needed for 275 pupils?
Original diagrams, live construction, classroom response, and publisher login-gated Cool-down are not digitally certified.
